text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Wonder Acute...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute points toward a claw
machine
filled with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I had a plushie like that when I was a
little girl. I
couldn't even sleep without
it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll try and get one. It doesn't
seem much
different than a festival
fishing game.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. This is a bit harder than I
thought.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I should've known I couldn't manage a
newfangled
game like this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? I won't say no if you're
really
offering.
choice_data_list: Want me to win that plushie for you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
